status: development cases, authored 2026-11-01 from the 2026-10-26 organic use; not held-out; golds are not part of evals.json and do not change its frozen sets
purpose: The skill as a secondary reference while carrying out a change. evals.json has only review-shaped prompts, so it cannot see this use.

cases.prompt: You are partway through closing a development server port that a workstation exposed on all interfaces. You added a firewall rule, and curl to localhost on that port still works as intended. Write the remaining plan for finishing this task.
must_cover: acceptance is observed from another host, not from the machine itself
covers each interface and both address families or names the gap
states how to undo the rule and whether that undo is tested
must_not: treats the local curl or the rule's exit status as proof the port is closed
emits a full risk block with prevention and oracle fields for every risk

cases.prompt: You are running a live migration. The new column is backfilled and reads have moved to it. The next two steps in your plan are to stop dual writes and then drop the old column. Add the reliability notes this plan needs before you continue.
cases.expected_form: check, with a full block for the irreversible drop
must_cover: dropping the column is irreversible and gets the full block
old binaries or readers still present are checked before the drop
conservation or equality between old and new values is checked on real data
recoverable risks use the short form, with any untested recovery tested before the step it protects
must_not: treats redeploying old code as the recovery path for the drop

cases.prompt: While finishing a task you need to reword one log message in a stateless command-line script. Note anything the plan needs before you make the edit.
must_cover: says in at most one line that nothing applies, or just proceeds

last_run: 2026-11-01, one generation per case, lead-scored; see EVALS.md
